answer_1.quote: We study the problem of generating clarifying questions for open-domain conversations ...

answer_2.quote: We use Precision, Recall, F1-Measure, and Mean Squared Error ... we also evaluate using Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR), Precision@1,3,5,10,20, and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (nDCG).

answer_4.quote: We conduct a pairwise human evaluation using the Acute-eval human annotation framework ... annotators evaluate Humanness, Engagingness, Interestingness, Knowledgeable, and Clarification.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown two full conversations and asked to answer questions about model performance on Humanness, Engagingness, Interestingness, Knowledgeable, and specifically which model asks better clarifying questions.
